_comment: Division templates. speed = km per hour-ish movement rating used by the movement system (step 9). 'equipment' is consumed when recruiting. 'required_tech' must be researched before the template can be recruited. 'support_attack_bonus' boosts other divisions attacking from the same battle. 'tactical_units' lists the 3 tactical unit types this division splits into in city battles (steps 15-17).

divisions.name: Infantry Division
divisions.description: Cheap, slow and good at holding ground.

divisions.name: Armored Division
divisions.description: Expensive, fast and built to break through.

divisions.name: Artillery Division
divisions.description: Support. Boosts the attack of divisions fighting alongside it.
